_what: tooling TL-GATE8: the code that decides which BYTES reach the per-step state hash for an unchanged world, and the sha256 of each piece at the last HASH_INPUT_EPOCH decision. tools/lint_hash_epoch.py reds when a piece changes without a decision (bump, or --neutral). Spans are `// HASH-INPUT BEGIN/END <id>` markers in the source; `span: null` watches the whole file.

history.reason: TL-GATE8 introduced at epoch 1. The committed state artifacts (3 libref fixtures, 2 UI-REC oracles) were stamped E=1 without re-capture: all five passed the 2026-09-25 15:33 full gate (libref 3/3 PASS, both --ui-abc PASS), which ran after df6d0af7 -- the last hashed-input change -- with no src/mh_dll change since.

mp:SES7: on_sim_step gains seg_tick() -- the per-match recording segment (opens/closes session-folder files, dumps a seed copy, mirrors log lines). It reads game state and writes only files; the bytes fed to the hash for an unchanged world are unchanged: relay_match hash IDENTICAL/898 and --determinism --det-local ALL PAIRS IDENTICAL (8000 and 1500 steps) on this build.

mp:D37b: on_sim_step's order-replay inject now picks order_replay_inject_prefix under the NEW opt-in [harness] replay_dispatch_inject knob; with the knob off (every existing config and artifact) the same order_replay_inject runs, so the bytes fed to the hash for an unchanged world do not change
mp:D38 row 5: harness on_sim_step gains the d38_* dead-docked-unit fixture (default off: d38_player=-1) -- no byte fed to the hash changes for an unchanged world

tooling:TL-HARN-INCHASH: the per-step hash loop moved out of on_sim_step into hash_step() over mh_harness/hash_kind.h (per_fnv / per_inc + fold; the new watched span harness_hash_kind_step), selected by [harness] hash_kind. Kind 1 (the default) runs the identical hash_slice loop and FNV fold over the same bytes -- inchashtest asserts per_fnv == hash_slice per slice and fold == the old combined/state fold -- so the bytes fed to the hash for an unchanged world are unchanged. Kind 2 hashes the same bytes (VERDICT-equivalent masks, mp:D39) into different VALUES; that is carried by the hash-kind token on the HASH FINGERPRINT line, not by an input-epoch change.
mp:X3c: harness combined/state made non-const so a world-resync import can re-derive them; the bytes fed to the hash for an unchanged world are identical
mp:X3c slice 3.5: harness synth_move is not re-issued for steps a resync catch-up replays (g_ws_replay_until); the bytes hashed for an unchanged world are unchanged
mp:U55 exit_process_at_step knob (ini-gated, default 0): no bytes fed to the hash change
mp:U55 exit_process_at_step knob (ini-gated, default 0) + log_flush: no bytes fed to the hash change

mp:U52 vision: harness-only vision_order/VISDUMP probes (unarmed by default); the vision seed writes only unhashed view masks (is_human, human mask, control mask are MF_VIEW without MF_HASH), so no hashed bytes of any world change
